description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's untracked cache functionality including setup, status checks, cache dumps, and behavior under various configurations and filesystem conditions.

methods.name: sync_mtime
methods.description: Updates the modification time of directories to ensure consistency before tests.

methods.name: avoid_racy
methods.description: Pauses execution briefly to avoid race conditions due to filesystem timestamp resolution.

methods.name: status_is_clean
methods.description: Checks that the git working directory is clean and the untracked cache is accurate.

methods.name: iuc
methods.description: Runs git ls-files commands with untracked cache enabled to simulate cache operations.

methods.name: get_relevant_traces
methods.description: Extracts relevant trace data related to directory reads for performance analysis.
